features.name: Reskilling Program
features.description: Microsoft program to recruit individuals from industry and retrain them to become Business Central professionals, consultants, or developers through a structured three-pillar approach involving hiring, training, and 6-month coaching.
caveats: Limited to partners experiencing talent gaps

features.name: Microsoft Talent Program
features.description: Training and onboarding program provided by Microsoft to ensure new hires are up and running quickly and have career perspective and job satisfaction.

features.name: New Hire Community
features.description: Community for new hires with onboarding flexibility allowing them to be onboarded at any moment and time.
